subject: Revenue routing & entitlement mapping for AWS CPPO handoff
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@resellco.com>, Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@cloudpartner.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Revenue routing & entitlement mapping for AWS CPPO handoff

Hi Matt / Jasmine —

Thanks again for the workshop yesterday. We committed to sending a minimal, executable plan for how the private offer will route revenue and provision entitlements so your billing team can reconcile with finance. Attached are two artifacts: an entitlement matrix (current mapping from SKU -> internal product ids) and a short PDF that outlines our suggested invoice split and the entity mapping options AWS supports for CPPO.

High-level proposal:
- Go-live target: 2027-05-03 (flex +/- 1 week)
- Revenue routing: Primary invoice to ResellCo (US entity), split line-item capture for reseller margin per SKU (see spec)
- Entitlements: Redwood will emit entitlement claims to AWS with the ResellCo customer identifier; ResellCo will accept provisioning via their marketplace subscriber flow

Action items for this thread (owning names inline):
1) Matt: confirm the legal entity (name + tax id) that should receive invoice(s) and whether ResellCo wants a single consolidated invoice or split by legal entity. (Due: 2027-04-13)
2) Kimberly: confirm any Redwood-side billing code changes required for the split (we think only invoice metadata is needed). (Due: 2027-04-14)
3) Ben: coordinate DocuSign for the PO and reseller addendum. (Due: 2027-04-15)
4) Priyom: validate entitlement matrix matches the latest SKU bundle. (Due: 2027-04-13)

We want to avoid a lengthy rework: if Matt can confirm entity + whether they accept invoice-split, we’ll open the CPPO with that config and route the first billing cycle accordingly.

Attachments: ResellCo-Entitlement-Matrix-v3.xlsx, CPPO-Invoice-Routing-Spec.pdf, PO-ResellCo-0427.pdf (stubbed).

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@resellco.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@cloudpartner.io>
Cc: accounting@resellco.com
Date: 2027-04-11T12:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue routing & entitlement mapping for AWS CPPO handoff

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear plan and the artifacts. A few quick clarifications from finance:
- Legal entity: ResellCo, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789) should receive the primary invoice.
- We prefer a single consolidated invoice to minimize AP overhead, but we do require margin line-items per SKU so we can allocate revenue internally. If AWS CPPO forces separate invoices per entity, we'll need the alternate flow; confirm if that's avoidable.

On entitlements: our provisioning team prefers entitlement claims to include both the AWS subscriber id and our internal reseller id (resellco-789). Can Redwood include both fields in the entitlement payload?

I'll loop in our accounting contact (cc'd) — they may ask for the back-of-envelope of how the invoice split will appear.

—Matt
Matt Sullivan
Head of Channel Sales | ResellCo
matt.sullivan@resellco.com
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue routing & entitlement mapping for AWS CPPO handoff

Quick update from Billing: we can support a single consolidated invoice with per-SKU line items (metadata fields captured). We will populate two custom invoice metadata keys: reseller_id and reseller_margin_pct. Those show up on the invoice PDF and in the exported CSV. That should satisfy ResellCo's allocation need without creating separate entity-level invoices.

About entitlement payloads: we can include reseller_id and aws_subscriber_id as claims. Priyom — please work with the runtime team to confirm the KV cache and provisioning flow can accept the extra claim.

I'll draft the invoice sample (one page) and attach in the next message for Matt/accounting to review.

—Kimberly
Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@resellco.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue routing & entitlement mapping for AWS CPPO handoff

Matt —

Thanks for confirming the entity. I kicked off the DocuSign envelope for the PO + reseller addendum (link below). It includes: PO-ResellCo-0427.pdf and the CPPO Addendum (terms that specify routing and revenue share). Please sign both. If accounting needs changes to billing address or tax info, let me know before signing.

DocuSign (embedded): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/embedded-sign/abc123-resellco-ppo

I also attached a sample invoice view for quick reference (stubbed image). If that layout works, Kimberly will push it into staging.

Next steps: once PO is signed and entitlement matrix agreed, I’ll submit CPPO with AWS and request parity for the invoice metadata tags.

—Ben
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Park <jasmine.park@cloudpartner.io>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@resellco.com>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-13T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue routing & entitlement mapping for AWS CPPO handoff

All —

Quick confirmation from our systems team: AWS supports custom invoice metadata keys and CPPO tagging for a single consolidated invoice. We validated with aws-ppo-support (copied). Also confirming: ResellCo's requested fields (aws_subscriber_id + reseller_id) can be present in the entitlement claim, but AWS will not surface custom claims to downstream billing reports unless explicitly mapped. Ben/Kimberly — please ask AWS to map reseller_id to the invoice line item metadata when you open the CPPO ticket.

Matt — as soon as you sign the DocuSign envelope and confirm the billing address on the PO, we can target the 2027-05-03 go-live.

Regards,
Jasmine Park
Marketplace Integrations | CloudPartner.io

On Tue, Apr 13, 2027 at 10:10 AM aws-ppo-support@amazon.com wrote:
> Hi team,
>
> We received an inquiry about CPPO billing metadata. AWS confirms you can include up to two custom invoice metadata fields per line item. To map those to downstream reports, include mapping instructions in your CPPO request.
>
> Regards,
> AWS CPPO Support
